name: be
description: BE — Plataforma integrada de inteligencia en salud

scripts.build:api: npm run build:domain && npm run build -w @be/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:domain && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build:domain && npm run test -w @be/domain && npm run test -w @be/api
scripts.test:integration: npm run build:domain && npm run test:integration -w @be/api
scripts.audit:prod: npm audit --omit=dev --audit-level=high -w @be/api && npm audit --omit=dev --audit-level=high -w @be/web && npm audit --omit=dev --audit-level=high -w @be/mobile
